segment.source: Simulate evolution with agents that search for food, reproduce and pass on mutating genes. Inspect individual agents and analyze population and gene distribution in charts.
segment.target: Kwaikwayi yadda halittun da ke neman abinci, haifar da ƴaƴa da watsa ƙwayoyin gado masu sauyawa suke canzawa. Duba halittu ɗaya bayan ɗaya, ka nazarci yawan halittu da rarrabuwar ƙwayoyin gado a jadawalai.
